# v0.1.15-beta.1

First prerelease candidate for the `0.1.15` stable line. It publishes only to npm `next`; it does not move npm `latest`.

## Highlights

- Improves Context7 automatic candidate selection so unrelated high-trust entries do not win over the requested library subject.
- Adds AnySearch repeatable `--param key=value` overrides and keeps successful `anysearch-extract --max-length` truncation local to the CLI.
- Makes disabled Tavily behavior explicit, classifies provider failures consistently, and reports smoke health as `healthy`, `degraded`, or `failed`.
- Adds a read-only CI matrix and a real tarball install smoke: a fresh temporary npm prefix must run version, packaged `smart-search regression`, and mock smoke successfully.

## Validation

- Source checkout: `python -m pytest tests -q`
- Source checkout: `python -m smart_search.cli regression`
- Source checkout: `python -m smart_search.cli smoke --mock --format json`
- Packed install: `smart-search --version`, `smart-search regression`, and `smart-search smoke --mock --format json`

## Install

```powershell
npm install -g @konbakuyomu/smart-search@0.1.15-beta.1
smart-search --version
```
